retrievalProfile.description: A dual-pane composition featuring a full-height vertical color block on the left and a warm-toned coastal portrait on the right with vertical text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split-screen design where the left third is a cool-toned, high-contrast blue and white graphic block, and the right two-thirds feature a warm, sepia-toned photograph of a person standing on a beach, accented by vertical sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between cool blue left pane and warm sepia right pane
Vertical alignment of text mirroring the standing subject's posture
Horizontal horizon line connecting the two disparate color zones
Asymmetrical balance with the subject positioned in the right third
coreInvariants: Vertical split-screen division at approximately 30% width
Monochromatic color wash applied to the left-hand pane
Vertical text orientation on the far right margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject standing in the right two-thirds, scaled to occupy 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the subject's clothing against the pale sand and sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left graphic element, moves across the horizontal name bar, down the subject's form, and finishes at the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and beach areas provide breathing room around the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and tan tones in the photographic section.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool cerulean and white in the left-hand vertical block.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Solid black for typography bars and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark subject and light background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized treatment for the top horizontal bar text
Extreme letter spacing for the vertical right-side text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold italicized display text for the name versus light, vertically-stacked lowercase for the title.
graphicDevices: Black rectangular background bar for top text
Abstract geometric 'T' shape in the top left corner

preserve: Black bar background for the top name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, impactful look of the top name bar.
Provides the geometric, airy feel required for the vertical side text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image. The left 30% is a high-contrast blue and white seascape. The right 70% is a warm sepia-toned photograph of a woman standing on a beach with arms crossed, looking to the side. Include a black horizontal bar in the top left and an abstract black geometric shape in the far top left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold italicized sans-serif text in white inside the black bar. Add light sans-serif text in black, oriented vertically with extreme letter spacing, along the far right edge of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the left pane distinctly blue compared to the warm right pane?
Is the text on the right oriented vertically?
Is the top text contained within a black rectangular bar?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left color block
Hue of the left color block
Tracking distance of the vertical text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Exact facial features of the subject

avoid: Overlapping the subject with the vertical text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the horizon line is level across both panes.
Ensure the vertical text is perfectly parallel to the right edge.
Verify the blue color block does not bleed into the sepia section.
Confirm the black bar is opaque and the white text is centered within it.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Color] vertical sidebar with a [Tone] portrait, using [Orientation] typography to create a balanced editorial layout.
